strategy: Source PAPER_LONG buys spot at first qualifying post-public observed book and exits at first qualifying target book; NO_TRADE holds cash. Reserve original forecasts before knowing execution success, decision or outcome. Stop continuous prefix at first missing entry/exit/source. No shorting.
hold_benchmark: Same initial1000 and first entry book, bought once, quantity held continuously through interval/cash gaps, valued using current bid-depth liquidation proxy with fees/slippage. Never repeatedly rebought at interval boundaries.
spread: Included by actual observed ask/bid depth sweeps; no separate half-spread assumption in nominal scenario
stress: Double fee and extra slippage, plus one observed half-spread each side as additional stress. Separate stress hold benchmark.
limitations: Paper execution is a visible quote/depth proxy, not actual fills or latency/impact certainty
Standard fee and extra slippage are declared research assumptions, not verified account-level cost
Sampled drawdown and missing marks/gaps are reported; continuous maximum drawdown not proven
New namespace cannot inherit legacy P2, old forecasts, old books, prior returns or prior activation
NO_TRADE intervals remain in coverage and require hold benchmark observations
Maturity and positive excess returns only allow independent paper review, never real-trading authorization

coverage_denominators.source: All closed original hourly slots with independent paired audit confirmation
